_stage_b_rule: B1 combined recipe: lr = the grid value in {0.0003, 0.001, 0.003} with the lowest score (the base lr 0.001 unless another qualifies); plus every optimizer knob (warm-up: warmup_frac 0.15 + warmup_max 2000; clip: grad_clip 3.0; weight decay: weight_decay 0.1) that qualified; plus the single shape knob (n_levels 3, n_levels 5, kernel 9, blocks_per_level 1, blocks_per_level 3) with the lowest score, if it qualified. Skip B1 if it equals a run already done. Score = mean of the last two heldout_loss values; qualifies = score below the reference (rung2_base_heldout) by more than delta_r = max(0.005, half the seed-0..2 range of the reference score).
